a: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
d:
If you don't know his favorite action movie, or what he thinks happens when we die, do you really know Peabody Award-winning late night host Stephen Colbert? Get to know Stephen on a deeper level with help from special guest questioners Mark Hamill, Jim Gaffigan, Jeff Daniels and Tiffany Haddish, and keep watching for parts three and four of the final edition of !
Watch The Late Show with Stephen Colbert weeknights at 11:35 PM ET/10:35 PM CT. Only on CBS.
